targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT symbol) as value FROM trading.bars_5m_current WHERE ts_end > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
SELECT count() as value FROM trading.bars_5m_current WHERE ts_end > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY

SELECT 
                max(ts_end) as value,
                toString(max) as formatted_time
            FROM trading.bars_5m_current
SELECT count(DISTINCT symbol) as value FROM trading.market_index_snapshots
SELECT count() as value FROM trading.ai_trader_dash_metrics WHERE date = today()
SELECT count() as value FROM trading.ai_trader_events WHERE kind='brain' AND ts > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
SELECT symbol, close, high, low, volume, toString(ts) as timestamp FROM trading.market_index_snapshots ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT ts_end as time, symbol, close as value FROM trading.bars_5m_current WHERE symbol LIKE '$symbol' AND ts_end > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts_end as time, symbol, volume as value FROM trading.bars_5m_current WHERE symbol LIKE '$symbol' AND ts_end > now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY ORDER BY ts

SELECT 
                        symbol,
                        count() as bars,
                        sum(volume) as total_volume,
                        avg(close) as avg_price,
                        max(close) as high,
                        min(close) as low
                    FROM trading.bars_5m_current 
                    WHERE ts_end > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
                    GROUP BY symbol 
                    ORDER BY total_volume DESC 
                    LIMIT 20

SELECT 
                        toString(ts_end) as time,
                        symbol,
                        open,
                        high,
                        low,
                        close,
                        volume
                    FROM trading.bars_5m_current 
                    WHERE symbol LIKE '$symbol'
                    ORDER BY ts_end DESC 
                    LIMIT 50
